title: STANDARD COURSE
intro: Some corners of tomomai NET are reserved for course members. Every tile and tab with an STD badge has been quietly leading you here.
introAccent: Prices include tax. Prices also include a joke.

standard.title: You are a Standard Course member!

premium.body: Everything is unlocked, the ribbon under the logo is gold, and dark mode is yours. Your rating is unchanged.

cancelFree.confirmAsk: Cancel the Light Course anyway? You would save ¥0 a month.
